scope: Read-only investigation of one user-reported Docker project; no task submission, project edits, build, or service changes.

raw_transcript.excluded_from_repository: Contains tool output including credentials; only aggregate evidence is retained here.

findings: Both complete implementation briefs reached the CLI user envelope unchanged.
Every recorded tool call has a corresponding tool-result record; observed delivery was under half a second.
The initial agent only surveyed the starter, but CLI success and successful starter build were reported as task success.
The retry repeatedly read instructions and source, changed only CSS, then timed out.
System events predominantly record thinking_tokens, not transport retries.
The instruction file explicitly requires replacing the starter and completing clear implementation requests without approval.
limits: Recorded tool results do not independently prove how an external model gateway processed conversation history.
Distinct CLI session IDs do not by themselves establish an unintended continuation bug.
No fresh paid model task or frontend build was run to test recovery.
Timeout preview status is not independently a live preview health result; the task cancellation context is used by post-task checks.
